coa NPM package maintainer hijack distributes malware

Target: coa
Repository: https://github.com/veged/coa
Date: 2021-11-04
Attribution: Individual Hacker
Component: Library
Language: Javascript
Cause: Compromised Account/Credentials
Motive: Credential Theft
Transitive: false
Impact Type: Data Exfiltration
User Impact:
Domain: npmjs.org (package host)
Artifact Type: source archive
Insertion Phase: distribution

Synopsis

Attacker compromised maintainer credentials for the 'coa' command-line argument parser library. Malicious versions were published containing password-stealing malware targeting Windows systems. This impacted downstream projects like 'rc'.
